WITH major_counts AS (
  SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM member
  GROUP BY link_to_major
),
overall AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members
  FROM major_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT mc.link_to_major, mc.member_count,
         1.0 * mc.member_count / o.total_members AS share
  FROM major_counts AS mc
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT s.link_to_major, s.member_count, s.share,
       1.0 * s.member_count / a.avg_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 10
